title: Grouped physical Mirror blocks with predicted asynchronous expert prefetch
hypothesis: At fixed GPU resident-byte cap and trained routing, predictive offload of the next physical block overlaps with K=4/5 useful Mirror outputs and beats native pre-gated + ordinary factorized + hot-prefolded strategies by >=15% TPOT in 4/5 fresh conditions at <=0.02 nat/token NLL difference.
physical_object: CPU resident expert groups and two GPU staging buffers
mirror_coordinate: short role/view address bank within each physical group
success_gate: Real GPU pinned-memory two-buffer trace with native predictor hit and >=15% faster P95 TPOT at same total actual VRAM and heldout NLL vs fastest native strong baseline in >=4/5 independent fresh prompts.
failure_gate: Same byte native pre-gated factor bank matches or exceeds, mispredicted bytes/sync consume benefit, or tensor caches copied but called aliased.
uncertainty: predictor hit rate, transfer bandwidth, CPU/GPU synchronization, clock, batch/context; 5 seeds small and hardware measurement currently unavailable
hardware: Stage-0 CPU + virtual event model executed; CUDA two-stream hardware stage BLOCKED
primary_dependency: MA-1175 SFM004 real jointly learned K outputs; do not claim generic prefetch as Mirror novelty
